camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribeProtoLogTotalCount --region cn-hangzhou --Site global --ToTime 1788395400000 --FromTime 1788393600000 --LogFilter '{"logicOp":"and","logFilterItems":[{"logField":"src_ip","op":"=","value":"192.0.2.10"}]}' --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Counts protocol log entries within a specified time range, site, and filter conditions. This operation can be used together with DescribeProtoLogs. The FromTime, ToTime, Site, and LogFilter parameters should be consistent between the two operations
description_zh: 统计指定时间范围、站点和过滤条件下的协议日志条数。可与 DescribeProtoLogs 配合使用；两个接口的 FromTime、ToTime、Site 和 LogFilter 应保持一致
name: DescribeProtoLogTotalCount

parameters.help_en: The log filter conditions in a JSON string. logicOp specifies and or or. logFilterItems is an array of conditions, each containing logField, op, and value, where value is a string. logFilters can contain nested condition groups of the same structure. If this parameter is not specified, no field-level filtering is applied. You can call ListProtoLogSupportIndex to obtain the available fields and operators
parameters.help_zh: 日志过滤条件，使用 JSON 字符串。logicOp 为 and 或 or；logFilterItems 为条件数组，每项包含 logField、op、value，value 使用字符串；logFilters 可嵌套同结构的条件组。不传时不附加字段过滤。可用字段和运算符通过 ListProtoLogSupportIndex 获取
parameters.name: log_filter

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the time 30 minutes before the current time is used. The value must not be later than the value of ToTime. Specify both the start time and end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。不传或传 0 时，使用当前时间前 30 分钟；须不晚于 ToTime。建议同时传入开始和结束时间
parameters.name: from_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the current time is used. The value must not be earlier than the value of FromTime. If FromTime equals ToTime, the system queries the time range from 1 second before ToTime to ToTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。不传或传 0 时，使用当前时间；须不早于 FromTime。当 FromTime 与 ToTime 相等时，系统按 ToTime 前 1 秒至 ToTime 的时间范围查询
parameters.name: to_time

parameters.help_en: The site for the log query. You can obtain valid values from the Sites field returned by DescribeDeliveryDestination. In multi-site scenarios, the specified site is used preferentially if it is available. If no site is specified or the specified site is unavailable, the system automatically selects an available site. If only one site is available, that site is used. If no site is available, LogDeliveryNotOpen is returned
parameters.help_zh: 日志查询站点，可从 DescribeDeliveryDestination 返回的 Sites 中获取。多站点场景下优先使用有效的指定站点；未指定或指定站点不可用时，系统自动选择可用站点。仅有一个可用站点时使用该站点；无可用站点时返回 LogDeliveryNotOpen
parameters.name: site

Data.description_zh: 协议日志数量统计结果

ProtoLogTotalCount.description_en: The number of protocol log entries that match the query conditions
ProtoLogTotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的协议日志条数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request succeeds. The example shows a scenario where the query range is invalid
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示查询范围无效场景

Message.description_en: The result message of the request. This parameter describes the error cause when the request fails. The example shows a scenario where the query range is invalid
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示查询范围无效场景

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
